Audio samples from OpenSpades Free Pak
https://github.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/tree/1e6b28721a2e5e51f84a572d101079bf186c66d5
Samples are bundled unmodified. Volume, pitch and stereo placement are adjusted during playback.
